grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Mei's Study Goals and Habits
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于学习目标和学习习惯的。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
Mei is a student at a language school in Shanghai. She studies English every day. She has a clear goal: she wants to pass the A2 English exam next month. To reach her goal, she has good study habits.

A. Daily Routine
Every morning, Mei gets up at 6:30. She listens to English for 20 minutes. She usually has breakfast at 7:00. Then she goes to school by bus. She often reviews new words on the bus. In the evening, she does her homework. She always goes to bed before 11:00. On Saturdays, she has a speaking class in the morning. She sometimes meets her classmates in the afternoon. They go to a café and talk in English. Mei likes this because she can practice with friends.

B. Study Habits
Mei studies in her room. She never studies in the living room because it is noisy. She sometimes studies with her friend, Li. They practice speaking together. Mei rarely watches TV. She thinks TV is not useful for learning English. She often uses a dictionary when she reads. She also writes new words in a small notebook. She reviews the notebook every evening. She says, "This notebook helps me remember words."

C. Goals and Progress
Mei's teacher says, "You are making good progress, Mei." Mei is happy. She is working hard for her exam. She wants to travel to Australia one day. She believes good habits help her learn better. She is also planning to read an English book next month. She thinks reading is fun and useful.

options: To pass the A2 English exam next month
To travel to Australia next year
answers: To pass the A2 English exam next month

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never）连用。现在进行时表示正在进行的动作，结构为 be (am/is/are) + 动词-ing。do/does 问句用于询问习惯或事实，第三人称单数用 does。
grammar.example: She often reviews new words on the bus. (一般现在时+频率副词) / She is working hard for her exam. (现在进行时) / Does she study in the living room? (do/does 问句)

options: She always goes to bed before 11:00.
She always go to bed before 11:00.
She is always go to bed before 11:00.
She always going to bed before 11:00.
answers: She always goes to bed before 11:00.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -s，所以用 goes。
questions.evidence: She always goes to bed before 11:00.

options: Does Mei study in her room?
Do Mei study in her room?
Does Mei studies in her room?
Is Mei study in her room?
answers: Does Mei study in her room?
questions.explanation: 主语 Mei 是第三人称单数，一般现在时问句用 Does 开头，动词用原形 study。
questions.evidence: Does Mei study in her room?

options: Mei is working hard for her exam.
Mei working hard for her exam.
Mei is work hard for her exam.
Mei works hard for her exam now.
answers: Mei is working hard for her exam.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时结构是 be + 动词-ing，主语 Mei 是第三人称单数，用 is working。
questions.evidence: She is working hard for her exam.
